lane_diff: +# nn_x/w11/pseudo copy (PSEUDO-DIRECT, reports/SOLVER_POWER_1113.md 6.3 item 3, 2026-11-14 ~00:10 UTC): runs from
+#   @W (its own logs/ preds/ ckpt/), GPUs N only by default (this agent's smoke grant; the lead sets
+#   W5_GPUS for the stage-E pair), stage-A variants w11_<arm>_s<seed>, stage-E variants w5_e10_<arm>_s<seed> as in nn_x/w5 (paired vs
+#   nn_x/w5's w5_e10_base_s951/952); PIDs go to nn_x/w11/pseudo/RUNNING.txt.
+#   Arms (cd_arms11.py; rule nn_x/w5/logs/E_pseudo_predeclared_DRAFT.txt): pseudo = --pseudo_ratio 1 (pseudo:real 1:1, weight 0.3, gap 16-64,
+#   head on); pseudo_xpre2 = pseudo + --xt cvnd (the pre2 columns dropped = nn_x/abl xdrop_pre2; information arm, substitution test);
+#   pseudo_noset = pseudo + --pseudo_noset 1 (set attention masked on pseudo rows; information); pseudo4 = --pseudo_ratio 4 (escalation dose).
-ALLOWED=${W5_GPUS:-"0 1 2 4"}
+ALLOWED=${W5_GPUS:-"7"}
-TL=@W/trunc_lifts_mbucket.json
+TL=<repo>/nn_x/w5/trunc_lifts_mbucket.json
+    A:pseudo|E:pseudo) echo "--pseudo_ratio 1" ;;  # wave-11 PSEUDO-DIRECT (cd_arms11.py): pseudo:real 1:1, weight 0.3, gap 16-64, head on
+    A:pseudo_xpre2|E:pseudo_xpre2) echo "--pseudo_ratio 1 --xt cvnd" ;;  # wave-11 information arm: pseudo + the 6 pre2 columns dropped (= abl xdrop_pre2)
+    A:pseudo_noset|E:pseudo_noset) echo "--pseudo_ratio 1 --pseudo_noset 1" ;;  # wave-11 information: set attention masked on pseudo rows
+    A:pseudo4|E:pseudo4) echo "--pseudo_ratio 4" ;;  # wave-11 escalation dose 4:1 (only after a PASS)
-RUN=logs/RUNNING_w5.txt
+RUN=RUNNING.txt  # nn_x/w11/pseudo/RUNNING.txt (wrapper PIDs; the REAL python PIDs are recorded there by the agent from /proc)
-    v=w5_${arm}_s${x}; args="$A_BASE $HYG --seed $x $f"
+    v=w11_${arm}_s${x}; args="$A_BASE $HYG --seed $x $f"  # nn_x/w11/pseudo: stage-A variants w11_<arm>_s<seed>
-    v=${v/w5_/w5_smoke_}; args="$args --train_feeds 20000 --epochs 1 --eval_every 25 --select_min_step 25 --cliplog 10"
+    v=${v/#w5_/w5_smoke_}; v=${v/#w11_/w11_smoke_}; args="$args --train_feeds 20000 --epochs 1 --eval_every 25 --select_min_step 25 --cliplog 10"
